data.title: 大凤 · 诊疗台护士服半解跨坐主动骑乘
data.description: 成年大凤独自跨坐诊疗软凳，护士裙敞开至腰际，一手抓凳沿、一手在白色长袜覆着的双腿间自抚。
data.location: 医务室皮质诊疗床中央
data.action: 独自跨坐诊疗软凳，一手抓凳沿、一手腿间自抚
data.lighting: 拉帘缝隙投射下的暖橙色斜阳打在起伏的雪肤与黑长双马尾上
data.promptProse: Seen from a low angle inside a quiet clinic lit by warm orange sunlight slanting past the curtain gap, Taihou sits astride the padded examination stool gripping its rim with flushed cheeks and breathless focus.
data.nsfwProse: Her pink nurse dress is unbuttoned and lifted around her waist to bare her chest above white thigh-high stockings and garter straps, her free hand slipping beneath the gathered hem.
data.animaCaption: Straddling the clinic examination stool in warm sunlight through parted curtains, she grips the stool edge with one hand while fingering herself between her white-stockinged thighs as her pink nurse dress hangs opened and gathered at her waist.
